verdict.rationale: Featurebase ships an official typed client SDK, featurebase-js, with a four-line install/boot flow (featurebase-docs-20, featurebase-probe-1). It adds an optional React helper for lifecycle and reactive state (featurebase-docs-21) and guidance for other frameworks (featurebase-docs-22), and the docs point to a full HTTP and SDK reference (featurebase-docs-2). The evidenced SDK covers the Messenger widget, while the REST APIs (posts, reports, training data) appear to be used over raw HTTP, and no OpenAPI spec could be found (featurebase-probe-2). Missing for 10: evidence of official server-side SDKs covering the REST API in multiple languages, a published OpenAPI spec for generating clients, and independent hands-on corroboration.
